limitations: Fixed valley terrain; seed changes are not independent generated terrain.
Warm windows are continuations after the first six game hours, not pre-taught or physiology-reset agents.
Positive food-association ablation preserves perception, navigation, practice, novelty/failure memory, bodily care and aversion; it is not all learning disabled.
Privileged capacity policy uses hidden plant/energy/eligibility information only inside this developer script; it is not an agent, achievable learned behavior, or indefinite food balance.

Selector arms are experimental: frozen/shuffled use identical learned warm-up for 900 seconds then freeze cost/outcome estimates; shuffled cyclically relabels their operation channels. Selector-cold uses neutral fixed estimates while preserving perception, negative gates, and ordinary food association learning.

Selector-reference is the original online policy from a separate frozen source root, not a warm-frozen estimate control. Only it versus selector isolates the gate. Choice diagnostics are copied developer-only records, not agent inputs; their session-local IDs are scoped to this trial.
No resets, food additions, energy assistance, changed physiology or Cardinal interventions. Native fixed timestep; no renderer or laptop performance claim.
postprocessingNotes: firstSustainedFeedbackAt is the first sustained food/energy feedback time; the frozen raw field firstPositiveAt does not include water relief.
